hotspots.title: Hungarian Orban Ex-Minister Buried Cash Corruption Scandal
hotspots.blurb: A massive corruption scandal surrounding former Fidesz minister Miklós Seszták and 6.5 billion HUF ($20M) in hidden cash allegedly found in a forest continues to disrupt Hungarian politics. Tisza Party leader Péter Magyar has aggressively attacked Viktor Orbán as a fallen mafia boss, while Fidesz figures exchange furious public accusations and file appeals to the Constitutional Court.
hotspots.affect: The combination of dramatic corruption imagery, heavy financial figures, and direct existential attacks between political rivals commands white-hot affective investment across Hungarian media.

hotspots.title: Vox 29N Campaign Launch & Remigration Push
hotspots.blurb: Vox is aggressively escalating its campaign for the November 29 elections, heavily pushing 'national priority' policies in housing, public services, and law enforcement while battling PP and PSOE for dominant positioning. Santiago Abascal has intensified attacks on Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez, framing the election as an existential battle for Spanish national identity amidst active street counter-protests.
hotspots.affect: High political polarization, aggressive campaign attacks, and clashes over national identity spark strong affective engagement across right-wing media.

hotspots.title: Macron-Le Pen Clash Over Ukraine Aid & 2027
hotspots.blurb: French presidential politics features an intense clash as Emmanuel Macron and his allies launch a sharp offensive against Marine Le Pen over her plan to halt financial support to Ukraine, asserting it will leave France isolated in Europe. Le Pen countered by accusing Macron of destroying the nation's finances and undermining French sovereignty ahead of the 2027 contest.
hotspots.affect: Sharp personal attacks over foreign policy betrayal and financial ruin generate high partisan outrage and existential fear framing.

hotspots.title: Javier Milei Ratifies 2027 Reelection Bid
hotspots.blurb: Argentine President Javier Milei has explicitly confirmed his intention to run for reelection in 2027 despite internal factional conflicts within La Libertad Avanza and political friction with Security Minister Patricia Bullrich. As economic pressure and plunging bond market confidence mount, Milei's administration is attempting to shift the narrative around long-term economic reforms and high-profile corporate milestones like Tesla's official launch in Argentina.
hotspots.affect: Contested political survival paired with internal coalition rifts and economic anxiety fuels high-heat media focus.

hotspots.title: AfD Nominates Thomas Berthold for Bundespräsident
hotspots.blurb: Alternative for Germany (AfD) drew sharp criticism across the political spectrum by nominating former World Cup soccer player and prominent lockdown critic Thomas Berthold for Federal President. The move, coming alongside controversy surrounding AfD-branded chocolate St. Nicholas figures, triggered public outrage and moral condemnation from church leaders and opposing political parties.
hotspots.affect: Provocative political stunt choices and culture-war symbolism spark moral outrage and intense pushback from establishment figures.
